name: Inferno
blurb: All spice bombs, all extreme. You were warned — literally.

cards.text: Edging the evening: kiss, touch, tease — but whoever breaks first and asks for more, loses control of the next three cards.
cards.soften: Ten slow kisses, no further than kissing.

cards.text: Undress completely. Sit where they can see you. They get sixty seconds to look, and you are not allowed to hide or fidget.
cards.speak: They narrate what they see — only compliments survive this round.
cards.soften: One item of clothing, their choice, sixty seconds of looking.

cards.text: What's the most intense thing you've ever wanted to do with me? Say it plainly. Plainness is the house style here.
They take the lead completely for five minutes — your only job is to receive, and to say 'yes' or 'there'. Nothing else is asked of you.
cards.soften: They lead a two-minute massage. You receive, full stop.

cards.text: Sensation duel: take turns blindfolding each other for two minutes each — warm hands, cool air, slow touch. Guess what's coming; earn a kiss for every right answer.
cards.soften: One blindfolded minute each, hands only.

cards.text: Whisper the fantasy you'd only tell me. Then roll for it: even — tonight, if we both still want it; odd — saved to the wish list, no pressure, no expiry.
cards.soften: Write it down, sealed, to be opened only by mutual agreement.

cards.text: The long way: skin-to-skin from shoulder to wrist, one inch per breath, both silent. Whoever speaks first restarts. The clock is not the point.
Trade one boundary each — something you'd want us never to do, said out loud, honored forever. Boundaries are how the wild stuff gets good.
